Definition: from G3819; antique, i.e. not recent, worn out:--old.
BiblicalUsage: Palaios is old, worn out, not recent. Our old man is crucified with Christ, we are to put off the old man which is corrupt, we have put off the old man with his deeds, and we are to purge out the old leaven that we may be a new lump.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the old man is not improved but crucified. God does not patch the old life, He puts it off and clothes me new in Christ.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
